title: How to Think for Yourself
paragraphs_en: There are some kinds of work that you can't do well without thinking differently from your peers. To be a successful scientist, for example, it's not enough just to be correct. Your ideas have to be both correct and novel.
What I'm going to discuss is the kind of thinking you need to have novel ideas. I call it "independent-mindedness," and the quality of being an independent thinker is something you can cultivate.
The three components of independent-mindedness work in concert: fastidiousness about truth finds new ideas, novelty energizes you, and strength of mind lets you hold onto them against opposition.
paragraphs_zh: 有些工作，如果你不能与同龄人有不同的思考方式，就无法做好。比如，要成为一个成功的科学家，仅仅正确是不够的。你的想法必须既正确又新颖。
我要讨论的是你产生新颖想法所需要的那种思维方式。我称之为“独立思考”，而成为独立思考者这种品质是可以培养的。
独立思考的三个组成部分协同运作：对真理的严谨态度帮你发现新想法，新颖性给你注入活力，而思想的坚定则让你在面对反对时依然坚守这些想法。
